crossRefs.note: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I today make you go up and down with us, since I go where I may? Return, and…
You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live…
Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahithophel
people.line: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide

translations.web: but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant in time past, so I will now be your servant; then will you defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.’
translations.bsb: But you can thwart the counsel of Ahithophel for me if you return to the city and say to Absalom: ‘I will be your servant, my king; in the past I was your father’s servant, but now I will be your servant.’
translations.kjv: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
translations.asv: but if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant in time past, so will I now be thy servant; then wilt thou defeat for me the counsel of Ahithophel.
